parts.name: Leg
parts.Basic_description: This is one leg of the pliers, made of carbon steel, typically around 10 cm long and 1 cm thick. It is part of the handle and jaw assembly.
parts.Functional_description: The leg acts as one of the two levers that provide the gripping and cutting force when the pliers are used. It transfers hand force to the jaws.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around the pivot joint relative to the other leg, allowing the jaws to open and close.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the base body of the pliers, made of carbon steel, approximately 10 cm long and 1 cm thick. It includes the pivot and one jaw.
parts.Functional_description: The base body provides structural support and houses the pivot mechanism that connects both legs, ensuring smooth operation and alignment.
parts.Movement_description: It remains mostly stationary relative to the pivot while the other leg moves, forming the fixed side of the gripping mechanism.
